title: Webb County Commissioners Question Concrete Job Cost at 1848 Event Center
excerpt: Webb County commissioners delayed a contract worth nearly $28,000 for concrete slabs at the 1848 Event Center, questioning why the price is more than twice an earlier estimate of about $13,000, according to KGNS.
content:
Webb County commissioners are questioning the cost of a concrete job at the 1848 Event Center, saying the price is more than twice an earlier estimate, according to KGNS.

The county wants to pour two concrete slabs inside the former show arena, a building now used for storage. On Monday, Nov. 9, commissioners delayed a contract worth nearly $28,000 after questioning the price.

The county Purchasing Department said the earlier quotes came in before the county had prepared engineering specifications for the work.

Precinct 3 Commissioner John Galo said he did not understand the price difference, noting the earlier quotes were around $13,000 and the new figure was $28,000, and he suggested asking bidders to bid again.

1848 Event Center Director Albert Torres said other quotes prepared using the new specifications came in lower. Purchasing still needs to check whether those lower bids match the specifications, and staff plans to bring more proposals back to the commissioners.

Source: KGNS — “Webb County commissioners question cost of concrete job at 1848 Event Center,” by Emma Galle (Nov. 13, 2026). kgns.tv
